pick.name: promptfoo
pick.what: CLI/YAML eval and red-team harness with CI, model comparison, local runs
pick.why: Language-neutral (TS monorepo + Python backends), declarative YAML Claude Code writes easily, red-teaming built in, runs locally on Windows
pick.maintained: 0.125.1 on 2026-10-25; acquired by OpenAI 2026-03-09 (README: 'remains open source and MIT licensed')

alts.name: DeepEval
alts.what: Pytest-style LLM evals: many metrics (RAG, agents, MCP), synthesizer
alts.why: Best Python-native option; partial TS integrations
alts.free_limits: Confident AI cloud optional (free account, limits unverified)

alts.name: Inspect AI (UK AISI)
alts.what: Research-grade eval framework: agents, sandboxes, 200+ benchmarks, log viewer
alts.why: Best for agent/tool-use evals and benchmark runs

candidates.name: promptfoo
candidates.verdict: Pick: language-neutral YAML+CI, red team; OpenAI-owned but MIT

candidates.name: Evalite 0.19.0 (2025-11)
candidates.verdict: Stale, no licence in npm metadata

decision: promptfoo remains the pick for cross-language CI-friendly evals, but OpenAI now owns it; MIT licence and local-only runs limit the risk (fork if governance changes). Use DeepEval if everything is Python, Inspect for deep agent evals.

verify.note: promptfoo 0.125.1 on 2026-10-25, MIT (registry); OpenAI acquisition flag retained.
